note: Mint-green alphabet classroom with a blue lino floor N–Z (cartoon style). Landmark: the big red post box with the postwoman (la lettre, feminine, front left). Letters N to U as sound figures in reading order: back row left to right N O P Q, front row R S T U. Zooms: the reading nook with beanbags in the back right corner holds V to Z; the blank chalkboard's ledge holds the grammar words. The open white door at the back left goes out to the school yard; the blue door on the right leads to the counting room.
